Account.title: Account
Account.description: Represents a financial account for a user or entity.

type.description: The type of the account (e.g., checking, savings, investment).

balance.description: The current balance of the account.

currency.description: The currency of the account (e.g., USD, EUR, NPR).

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this account.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the NeupLedger application.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the User, matching Firebase Auth UID.

accountId.description: The name of the account/ledger the user is currently operating.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile information, keyed by their Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/accounts/{accountId}.description: Stores financial accounts for each user, ensuring data isolation.
